change: From rm-snapshot 1.0.2 (2026-11-19): fixes a display defect found in browser testing of the integrated funnel. A household with no Social Security or pension income showed '+$-0' on the 'Social Security & pensions' line of the breakdown. Amounts now never show a negative zero, and a zero line shows '$0' with no sign. No change to copy, branch selection, rounding rules or engine values. 1.0.1: the no-estimate message uses the live funnel's rate-data rule. Display layer for the redesigned Retirement Snapshot: formatter (branch selection and display rounding rules R1-R5), the approved copy library, a page fragment with styles scoped to .rms, and Print / Save as PDF (US Letter print layout, details expanded and the rest of the page hidden while printing). Never changes engine values. API: RMSnapshot.build(base, comparison, ctx) and RMSnapshot.render(container, base, comparison, ctx, opt). ctx: firstName, priorities (A.confidence, A.confidence2), state, totalAssets, bookingAllowed, two, inputs (the rm-box answers), optionA, prelim, mixEstimated, quoteDates, asOfYear.

Print: 165 checks across H1, H12, H20, E13 and Option A at 1280 px and 390 px: 0 failures. Browser parity: 49 of 49 households identical to the reference in Chromium.
